free_tier_limits: 100 requests/month free; EUR base currency only; conversion, time-series, and fluctuation endpoints require paid plans
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Verifier B partly correct. Official pricing (fixer.io/pricing, Aug 2026) confirms Free = 100 API calls/mo; no All Base Currencies (EUR-only); Conversion from Basic+; Time-Series from Professional+; Fluctuation from Professional Plus+. SSL Encryption is listed on Free in current pricing (Verifier B’s “HTTPS not available” is outdated). Original omitted paid-endpoint gates; B overstated HTTPS restriction. Corrected to match current official matrix without the HTTPS claim.
